periblast.definition:
a. The protoplasmic matter which surrounds the entoblast,
   or cell nucleus, and undergoes segmentation.

periblem.definition: n. Nascent cortex, or immature cellular bark.

peribole.translation: [建]建筑物周围的室外环境(尤指装饰有雕塑像等者)

peribolos.definition:
n. In ancient architecture, an inclosed court, esp., one
   surrounding a temple.
peribolos.translation: n. ( 圣地或圣殿的) 围墙

peribolus.translation: n. ( 圣地或圣殿的) 围墙

peribranchial.definition:
a. Surrounding the branchiae; as, a peribranchial
   cavity.
a. Around the bronchi or bronchial tubes; as, the
   peribronchial lymphatics.
